Method of Attack: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via serialization to set properties of a class
Creation of malicious JSP files to execute commands or gain reverse shell access
Attack Vector: Exploitation of request mapping in Spring Framework controllers
Manipulation of logging properties to create malicious JSP files
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of malicious JSP files such as /myapp/rce.jsp
Execution of commands like 'whoami' via URLs such as http://localhost:8080/tomcatwar.jsp?pwd=j&cmd=whoami
Injected content in JSP files like <% out.println(“HACKED”); %>
